g.text: Rearm needs a fresh post-commit ACK edge. Health recovery or collision removal cannot create a clock edge or restart output.

g.desc: Rearm needs a fresh post-commit ACK edge. Health recovery or collision removal cannot create a clock edge or restart output.

g.text: Ideal logic only: setup/hold, all-off settling, voltage, independent watchdog and actual current observation remain mandatory.

g.desc: Ideal logic only: setup/hold, all-off settling, voltage, independent watchdog and actual current observation remain mandatory.

g.text: BASE_HEALTH = RESET & RAILS & WATCHDOG & AFE_ISOLATED_READY & MON0 & MON1; QUIET_SAFE additionally requires both WANT/REQUEST/RUN low and quiescence.

g.desc: BASE_HEALTH = RESET & RAILS & WATCHDOG & AFE_ISOLATED_READY & MON0 & MON1; QUIET_SAFE additionally requires both WANT/REQUEST/RUN low and quiescence.

g.text: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / RESTRICTED 24 V, 3 mA SOURCES / ARTIFICIAL LOADS ONLY

g.desc: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / RESTRICTED 24 V, 3 mA SOURCES / ARTIFICIAL LOADS ONLY

g.text: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.

g.desc: Sixteen selectable stimulation contacts, two dedicated monitored returns; command-level routing is not measured continuity or isolation.

g.text: Any COMMIT invalidates prior validation and ACK. Illegal COMMIT holds active bits and captures COMMIT_SEEN=0.
